variants.definition: preserve Y exactly in YCbCr; rotate each centered (Cb-128, Cr-128) vector by +90 degrees; preserve chroma magnitude before gamut clipping; return RGB
preserve target luminance; transfer only chroma mean/covariance from a deterministic context-only donor palette using a frozen colour-transfer transform; geometry and luminance remain target-derived

naturalistic_palette_donors.selection: deterministic stable-hash donor per target from a different environment where possible and the same label
naturalistic_palette_donors.reason: create a plausible alternate colour palette without changing target geometry/luminance

quality_gate.matched_rotation: verify luminance preservation and intended chroma-magnitude preservation before clipping
quality_gate.naturalistic_counterfactual: visual plausibility + target luminance/geometry preservation on all PoC images

interpretation.naturalistic_counterfactual_drop: stronger evidence that chromatic cues materially influence the frozen model
